about: Injury knockdown V1 (docs/gameplay/injury_knockdown_v1_plan.md): hit from the right: a step out, onto the LEFT side, the left hand first, down at 0.55 s (the thump; mirrored when hit from the left), a breath, rolled onto all fours, half kneel, push on the knee, up. 3.7 s (health/FallLanding). The whole body (mask full), held (hold_body: arms keyed by FK); the own first person draws the body, the camera on the posed eye, the view following first_person_view. No moving or using items meanwhile (client/skeleton/FallLandingClient). Written by tools/medical-actions-v1a/author_knockdown_v1.cjs.
